questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.topic: Judgment as a matter of law
questions.question:
A railroad worker's widow brought a wrongful death action in federal court against the railroad, claiming that its negligence had caused her husband's death. At trial, the widow offered the testimony of a coworker of the husband. The coworker testified that he had seen the rail car on which the husband was riding slow down and the cars behind it gain speed. The coworker also stated that he later heard a loud crash, but did not turn around to look because loud noises were common in the yard. Three other railroad employees testified that no collision had occurred.
At the close of the evidence, the railroad moved for judgment as a matter of law, which was denied, and the case was submitted to the jury. The jury returned a verdict for the widow.
The railroad has made a renewed motion for judgment as a matter of law.
What standard should the court apply to determine how to rule on the motion?

choices.A: Whether the evidence revealed a genuine dispute of material fact supporting the widow's claim.
choices.B: Whether the verdict is against the weight of the evidence.
choices.C: Whether the widow presented a scintilla of evidence to support the verdict.
choices.D: Whether there is substantial evidence in the record to support the verdict, resolving all disputed issues in the widow's favor.

questions.explanation:
Motion for judgment as a matter of law
(FRCP 50)
Time to file
  • May be filed after nonmovant presents its case but before case is submitted to jury (i.e., motion for a directed verdict)
  • May be renewed within 28 days after entry of final judgment (i.e., motion for judgment notwithstanding the verdict)
Procedural
requirements
  • Movant must:
    • specify judgment sought & law/facts entitling movant to judgment
  • Court must:
    • view evidence & draw all reasonable inferences in nonmovant's favor
    • disregard evidence favorable to movant that jury is not required to believe
    • not consider credibility of witnesses or evaluate weight of evidence
Standard for grant Evidence is legally insufficient for reasonable jury to find in nonmovant's favor

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A motion for judgment as a matter of law (JMOL) may be filed before the case is submitted to the jury. If denied, a renewed motion for JMOL can be filed after trial—as the railroad did here. The standard the court will apply is whether the evidence is legally sufficient for a reasonable jury to find in the nonmovant's favor. This means that the motion will be denied if there is substantial evidence in the record to support a verdict for the nonmovant.

When making this determination, the court must view the evidence and draw all reasonable inferences in the light most favorable to the nonmovant. Therefore, all disputed issues must be resolved in the widow's favor.

(Choice A) Whether the evidence revealed a genuine issue of material fact would be pertinent to a motion for summary judgment, which must be made before trial.

(Choice B) A party may move for a new trial on several grounds, one of which is that the verdict is against the clear weight of the evidence.

(Choice C) Historically, a court would deny a motion for JMOL if a scintilla (ie, very small amount) of evidence supported a verdict for the nonmovant. Today, all federal courts and most state courts require that the verdict be supported by substantial evidence.

📌 Educational Objective

The standard applied by a court in deciding a motion or renewed motion for judgment as a matter of law is whether there is legally sufficient (ie, substantial) evidence in the record to support a verdict for the nonmovant. The court must view the evidence and draw all reasonable inferences in the nonmovant's favor.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 50 (judgment as a matter of law).
  • 46 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 319 (explaining the standard for judgment as a matter of law).
questions.zh-question:
一名铁路工人的遗孀在联邦法院对铁路公司提起不当致死诉讼，声称该公司的疏忽导致了她丈夫的死亡。在审判中，遗孀提供了丈夫一位同事的证词。该同事作证说，他看到丈夫所乘坐的轨道车减速，而后面的车厢加速。该同事还说，他后来听到了巨大的撞击声，但没有回头看，因为在车场里巨大的噪音很常见。另外三名铁路员工则作证说没有发生碰撞。

在证据出示结束后，铁路公司申请了法律上判决，但该申请被驳回，案件被提交给陪审团。陪审团作出了有利于遗孀的裁决。

铁路公司再次提出了法律上判决的动议。

法院应适用什么标准来决定如何裁定该动议？

zh-choices.A: 证据是否揭示了支持遗孀主张的重大事实的真实争议。
zh-choices.B: 裁决是否与证据的权重相悖。
zh-choices.C: 遗孀是否提供了些微证据来支持该裁决。
zh-choices.D: 记录中是否有充分证据支持该裁决，并且所有争议问题均以对遗孀有利的方式进行解释。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：法律上判决

正确答案：D

记录中是否有充分证据支持该裁决，并且所有争议问题均以对遗孀有利的方式进行解释。

1. 核心考点：JMOL 标准

本题考查的是法律上判决的动议（Motion for Judgment as a Matter of Law, 简称 JMOL），依据为《联邦民事诉讼规则》第 50 条（FRCP 50）。

规则要点：
当一方在审判后提出“再次 JMOL 动议”（Renewed Motion for JMOL）时，法院的审查标准是非常严格的。法院必须判定：
“一个理性的陪审团是否有法律上充分的证据基础（Legally Sufficient Evidentiary Basis）来支持该裁决。”

2. 深度解析与推理逻辑

要正确回答此题，必须掌握法院在审查 JMOL 时必须遵循的两个原则：

  • 充分证据 (Substantial Evidence)： 法院不要求证据确凿无疑，但必须超过“些微”（Scintilla）程度。必须有足够的证据让理性的陪审员能够得出该结论。
  • 最有利于非动议方 (Light Most Favorable to Non-Movant)： 这是解题的关键。法院不能评估证人的可信度（Credibility）或衡量证据的权重（Weigh the evidence）。

    在本案中，虽然有三名员工说没发生碰撞，但有一名同事说听到了撞击声。法院必须假设这名同事说的是真话（即以对遗孀有利的方式解释争议），并忽略掉陪审团可能不相信的反方证据。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

理解干扰项的设计逻辑对于排除法解题至关重要：

选项 错误原因 适用场景
A 这是即决判决 (Summary Judgment) 的标准。 审判前 (Pre-trial) 使用，看是否有必要开庭。
B 这是重新审判 (Motion for New Trial) 的标准。 如果裁决“违背证据权重”，法官可以命令重审，但不能直接判另一方胜诉（JMOL）。
C “些微证据” (Scintilla) 标准已过时。 联邦法院要求的是“充分证据” (Substantial Evidence)。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)：
在 MBE 考试中，区分 JMOL 和 New Trial 是高频考点。
  • JMOL (FRCP 50): 门槛极高。法官不能衡量证据权重。结果是直接改判。
  • New Trial (FRCP 59): 门槛稍低。法官可以衡量证据权重（觉得陪审团搞错了）。结果只是重来一次，不是直接改判。
看到题目问“Judgment as a Matter of Law”，立即寻找包含“Substantial Evidence”且“View in light most favorable to non-movant”的选项。

questions.question:
A woman sued her former employer in federal court for sexual discrimination in violation of federal law. At the jury trial, the woman presented evidence that she had been repeatedly passed over for promotions that went to her less-qualified male colleagues. After the woman rested her case, the employer presented evidence that the promotions were made pursuant to a merit-based system that did not take sex into account. To rebut the employer's evidence, the woman provided witness testimony that the system was just a pretext to discriminate against female employees.
At the conclusion of evidence, the employer moved for judgment as a matter of law. Viewing the evidence in the light most favorable to the employer, the court granted the employer's motion. Twenty-two days later, the woman appealed the district court's entry of judgment as a matter of law.
Is the appellate court likely to overturn the judgment as a matter of law?

choices.A: No, because the entry of judgment as a matter of law was appropriate under the circumstances.
choices.B: No, because the woman failed to timely appeal the district court's entry of judgment as a matter of law.
choices.C: Yes, because the district court failed to follow the proper procedural requirements in assessing the motion for judgment as a matter of law.
choices.D: Yes, because the employer failed to move for judgment as a matter of law at the close of the woman's case-in-chief.

questions.explanation:
Motion for judgment as a matter of law
(FRCP 50)
Time to file
  • May be filed after nonmovant presents its case but before case is submitted to jury (i.e., motion for a directed verdict)
  • May be renewed within 28 days after entry of final judgment (i.e., motion for judgment notwithstanding the verdict)
Procedural requirements
  • Movant must:
    • specify judgment sought & law/facts entitling movant to judgment
  • Court must:
    • view evidence & draw all reasonable inferences in nonmovant's favor
    • disregard evidence favorable to movant that jury is not required to believe
    • not consider credibility of witnesses or evaluate weight of evidence
Standard for grant Evidence is legally insufficient for reasonable jury to find in nonmovant's favor

A party may move for judgment as a matter of law (JMOL) at any time after the nonmovant has had an opportunity to present its case-in-chief but before the case is submitted to the jury. A motion for JMOL is a request that the court enter a judgment in favor of the movant because the evidence is legally insufficient for a reasonable jury to find in the nonmovant's favor. When considering such a motion, the district court must:

  • view the evidence and draw all reasonable inferences in the light most favorable to the nonmovant
  • disregard any evidence favorable to the movant that the jury is not required to believe and
  • not consider the credibility of witnesses or evaluate the weight of evidence.

(Choice D) Here, the employer timely moved for JMOL after the woman presented her case-in-chief and before the case was submitted to the jury. However, the district court improperly viewed the evidence in the light most favorable to the employer (movant). As a result, the entry of JMOL was not appropriate under the circumstances, and the appellate court will likely overturn it (Choice A).

(Choice B) A party generally must appeal an adverse ruling, judgment, or order within 30 days after the entry of final judgment.* Therefore, the woman timely appealed the JMOL 22 days after it was entered.

*The time to appeal is extended to 60 days if one of the parties is (1) the United States, (2) a federal agency, or (3) a federal officer or employee sued for conduct that relates to government duties.

📌 Educational Objective

When considering a motion for JMOL, the district court must (1) view the evidence and draw all reasonable inferences in the light most favorable to the nonmovant, (2) disregard any evidence favorable to the movant that the jury is not required to believe, and (3) not consider the credibility of witnesses or evaluate the weight of evidence.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 50(a) (motion for judgment as a matter of law).
  • Reeves v. Sanderson Plumbing Prods., Inc., 530 U.S. 133, 150–51 (2000) (explaining the procedural requirements for considering a JMOL motion).
questions.zh-question:
一名女子在联邦法院起诉其前雇主，指控其违反联邦法律进行性别歧视。在陪审团审判中，该女子出示证据表明，她多次在晋升中被忽略，而晋升机会被给予了资历较浅的男同事。在该女子完成其案情陈述后，雇主出示证据表明，晋升是依据一个不考虑性别的绩优制度作出的。为了反驳雇主的证据，该女子提供了证人证言，指出该制度只是歧视女性雇员的借口。

在证据出示结束时，雇主申请了法律问题判决（judgment as a matter of law）。法院以对雇主最有利的方式审视证据，并批准了雇主的动议。二十二天后，该女子对地区法院作出的法律问题判决提起了上诉。

上诉法院是否可能推翻该法律问题判决？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为在此情况下，作出法律问题判决是适当的。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为该女子未能及时对地区法院作出的法律问题判决提起上诉。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为地区法院在评估法律问题判决的动议时，未能遵循适当的程序要求。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为在该女子的主案陈述结束时，雇主未能动议作出法律问题判决。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

民事诉讼法 (Civil Procedure)
正确答案：C

是的，因为地区法院在评估法律问题判决（JMOL）的动议时，未能遵循适当的程序要求。

核心考点：JMOL 的审查标准

规则来源： FRCP 50 (Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 50)

法律问题判决 (Judgment as a Matter of Law, JMOL) 的核心原则是：法院在决定是否批准该动议时，必须以对非动议方 (Non-movant) 最有利的方式查看证据。

具体要求包括：

  • 视角： 必须以对非动议方（本案中为原告女子）最有利的角度审视证据。
  • 推断： 必须作出所有对非动议方有利的合理推断 (Reasonable Inferences)。
  • 禁忌： 法院不得衡量证据的权重 (Weigh evidence) 或评估证人的可信度 (Credibility)。
  • 忽略： 法院应忽略陪审团没有义务相信的、有利于动议方的证据。
本案案情分析

在本案中，发生了以下关键步骤：

  1. 雇主（被告）提出了 JMOL 动议。
  2. 这意味着雇主是动议方 (Movant)，原告女子是非动议方 (Non-movant)。
  3. 错误所在： 题目明确指出法院“以对雇主（动议方）最有利的方式审视证据” (Viewing the evidence in the light most favorable to the employer)。

这是严重的程序错误。如果法院正确地以对原告最有利的方式看证据（包括她关于晋升制度是“借口”的证词），一个理性的陪审团完全可能支持原告，因此法院不应批准 JMOL。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误

判决并不适当。因为法院应用了错误的审查标准（偏向了动议方），导致原告被剥夺了由陪审团审理事实的权利。

选项 B 错误

上诉时效： 根据联邦上诉程序规则 (FRCP 4 of Appellate Procedure)，当事人通常有 30天 时间对最终判决提起上诉。本案中原告在 22 天后上诉，属于及时上诉。

选项 D 错误

动议时机： FRCP 50(a) 规定，JMOL 可以在“非动议方被完全听取”后的任何时间提出，直到案件提交给陪审团之前。雇主在双方证据出示完毕后提出动议是完全合法的，并不必须在原告主案结束时立即提出。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到 Summary Judgment (FRCP 56) 或 JMOL (FRCP 50) 的题目时，永远记住黄金法则：

"Light most favorable to the NON-MOVANT"

（以对非动议方最有利的方式看待证据）

如果题目说法院偏向了动议方，或者法院自己去衡量了证人可信度，那么法院的裁决通常是错误的。

questions.question:
A man from State A sued a woman from State B in a proper federal district court to recover $250,000 for the damage to his car and personal injuries he suffered when the two were involved in a car accident at a four-way intersection. The man requested a jury trial. The only issue in dispute is who had the green light as the cars approached the intersection.
At trial, the man called his 18-year-old son to the stand. The son testified that he was sitting in the passenger seat of the man's car and that his father was driving reasonably. On cross-examination, the son admitted that he did not see the light as the man's car approached the intersection. The man called no other witnesses and presented no other evidence.
In her defense, the woman called five witnesses to the accident. All five testified that the woman had the green light as she approached the intersection.
At the close of evidence, the woman's attorney moved for judgment as a matter of law. The court denied this motion and allowed the case to go to the jury. After deliberating for twenty minutes, the jury returned a verdict in favor of the man.
If the woman seeks to overturn the jury's verdict and obtain a judgment in her favor, which of the following actions would most effectively and efficiently accomplish her goal?

choices.A: Move for a judgment on partial findings.
choices.B: Move for a new trial.
choices.C: Petition for writ of mandamus.
choices.D: Renew her motion for judgment as a matter of law.

A motion for judgment as a matter of law (JMOL or directed verdict) is a request that the court issue a judgment in favor of the movant because the evidence is legally insufficient for a reasonable jury to find in the nonmovant's favor. This motion can only be filed after the nonmovant has presented its case but before the case is submitted to the jury. That is because the motion, if granted, removes the case from the jury's consideration.

If a motion for JMOL is denied during trial (as seen here), the movant can file a renewed motion for JMOL no later than 28 days after the entry of judgment. A judge can grant the renewed motion even if the original motion was denied. This is often done so that, if the trial court's decision is overturned on appeal, the jury's verdict can simply be reinstated instead of a new trial being required. The motion also provides an effective and efficient means to overturn a jury verdict—especially here, since the evidence on the green light overwhelmingly favors the woman.

(Choice A) A judgment on partial findings is analogous to a JMOL but is used when a case is tried before a judge—not a jury (as seen here).

(Choice B) The losing party can file a motion for new trial within 28 days after the court enters a final judgment. But a second trial would be expensive and time-consuming, so this motion would not provide the most efficient means to obtain a favorable judgment.

(Choice C) A petition for writ of mandamus is a rare procedure that allows a party to seek appellate review before a final judgment is issued—but only when no other remedy (eg, JMOL) is available.

📌 Educational Objective

A motion for judgment as a matter of law is used to remove a case from the jury's consideration when there is legally insufficient evidence for a reasonable jury to find in the nonmovant's favor. The motion can be renewed within 28 days after the entry of judgment to seek to overturn an adverse verdict.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 50 (judgment as a matter of law).
questions.zh-question:
一名来自A州的男子在一家有管辖权的联邦地区法院起诉了一名来自B州的女子，要求赔偿其因卷入一场四向十字路口车祸而遭受的25万美元车损和人身伤害。该男子请求了陪审团审判。案件中唯一的争议点是，当两车驶近十字路口时，哪一方是绿灯。

在审判中，该男子传唤其18岁的儿子出庭作证。儿子作证说，他当时坐在男子汽车的乘客座位上，且他的父亲驾驶合理。在交叉询问中，儿子承认当男子的车驶近十字路口时，他没有看到交通灯。该男子没有传唤其他证人，也没有出示其他证据。

在辩护中，该女子传唤了五名事故目击证人。五名证人均作证说，当女子驶近十字路口时，她是绿灯。

在证据出示阶段结束时，女子的律师提出了“法律问题的判决”(judgment as a matter of law)动议。法院驳回了该动议，并允许案件交由陪审团审理。经过二十分钟的商议，陪审团作出了有利于该男子的裁决。

如果该女子希望推翻陪审团的裁决并获得有利于自己的判决，以下哪项行动能最有效且最高效地实现她的目标？

zh-choices.A: 动议“基于部分事实的判决”(judgment on partial findings)。
zh-choices.B: 动议重新审判。
zh-choices.C: 请求签发“执行令”(writ of mandamus)。
zh-choices.D: 重新提出她的“法律问题的判决”(judgment as a matter of law)动议。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 民事诉讼法考点解析

Federal Rules of Civil Procedure Rule 50
正确答案：D 重新提出她的“法律问题的判决”动议
(Renew her motion for judgment as a matter of law)
核心考点：JMOL 与 RJMOL

本题考察的是联邦民事诉讼规则第50条（FRCP Rule 50）关于“法律问题的判决”（Judgment as a Matter of Law, 简称 JMOL）及其更新动议（Renewed JMOL, 简称 RJMOL）的适用程序。

1. 什么是 JMOL?

如果在庭审中，一方当事人已被充分听取意见，但没有法律上充分的证据基础（legally sufficient evidentiary basis）支持理性的陪审团作出有利于该方的裁决，法院可以批准 JMOL，直接判该方胜诉，无需陪审团裁决。

2. 什么是 RJMOL (Rule 50(b))?

如果法院驳回了庭审中的 JMOL 动议，案件交给陪审团后，动议方可以在判决登记后28天内再次提出该动议（即“更新”动议）。

关键前提：要提出 RJMOL，当事人必须在案件提交给陪审团之前（通常是证据出示结束时）已经提出过 JMOL 动议。
案情分析

在本案中，女方（被告）满足了所有 RJMOL 的条件：

  1. 证据不足：原告（男方）唯一的证人（儿子）承认没看到红绿灯。原告没有提供任何证据证明他是绿灯。因此，理性的陪审团不可能判原告胜诉。
  2. 程序正确：女方律师在证据出示结束时（at the close of evidence）已经提出了 JMOL 动议，但被法官驳回。
  3. 目标明确：题目问的是如何“最有效且高效”地获得有利于她的判决。

通过提出 RJMOL，法官可以直接推翻陪审团不合理的裁决，直接判女方胜诉（Entry of Judgment），这比重新审判更高效。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A (Judgment on partial findings) 错误：
此动议（FRCP Rule 52）仅适用于法官审判（Bench Trial/Non-jury Trial）。本案明确说明是陪审团审判（Jury Trial）。
选项 B (New Trial) 错误：
虽然女方可以申请重新审判（FRCP Rule 59），但这并不是“最有效且高效”的手段。重新审判意味着要花费更多的时间和金钱重走一遍流程。既然原告完全没有证据，女方理应直接获得胜诉判决，而不是重审。
选项 C (Writ of Mandamus) 错误：
执行令（Mandamus）是一种非常规的、极端的上诉救济手段，仅在没有其他法律救济途径时使用。既然规则中已有 RJMOL 这一标准程序，就不适用执行令。
考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 考试中，如果题目问“最有效率”（efficient）的方式，且一方证据明显不足（legally insufficient），通常答案是指向直接终结案件的程序（如 Summary Judgment 或 JMOL/RJMOL），而不是指向重新开始的程序（如 New Trial）。

记住 RJMOL 的“两步走”规则：必须先有庭审中的 JMOL (Rule 50(a))，才能有庭审后的 RJMOL (Rule 50(b))。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A boutique sued a dressmaker in federal court for breach of contract. The boutique's complaint alleged that the dressmaker violated the contract between the parties by delivering the wrong dresses. The dressmaker immediately filed an answer, in which he admitted to delivering the wrong dresses. The answer also contained an affirmative defense that the boutique failed to file its complaint within the applicable statute of limitations.
The dressmaker wants the court to decide the case based solely on the information contained in the complaint and answer.
Which motion will best accomplish the dressmaker's goal?

choices.A: A motion for default judgment.
choices.B: A motion for judgment as a matter of law.
choices.C: A motion for judgment on the pleadings.
choices.D: A motion for summary judgment.

questions.explanation:
Explanation
Pretrial motions
Motion Grounds
Default judgment
  • Defendant failed to timely serve answer
  • Any party failed to comply with court order
Pre-answer
  • No subject-matter or personal jurisdiction
  • Improper venue
  • Insufficient process or service of process
  • Failure to join required party
  • Failure to state claim upon which relief can be granted
Judgment on the pleadings
  • Pleadings, attached exhibits & matters of public record show (1) no genuine dispute of material fact & (2) movant entitled to judgment as a matter of law
Voluntary dismissal
  • Plaintiff requests dismissal
Involuntary dismissal
  • Defendant requests dismissal because plaintiff failed to (1) prosecute action or (2) comply with rule/court order
Summary judgment
  • Pleadings, affidavits, declarations, discovery & other materials show (1) no genuine dispute of material fact & (2) movant entitled to judgment as a matter of law

A motion for judgment on the pleadings can be used to dismiss a suit once the pleadings have closed—i.e., when all required pleadings have been served. Since the court's consideration of this motion is limited to the contents of the pleadings (including attached exhibits) and matters of public record, this motion will best accomplish the dressmaker's goal.

The motion will likely be granted if the pleadings show that the statute of limitations has expired because there would be no issues of material fact and the dressmaker would be entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

(Choice A) A default judgment is appropriate (1) when a defendant fails to timely serve an answer or (2) as a sanction when a party fails to comply with a court order—neither of which applies here.

(Choice B) A party can move for judgment as a matter of law during trial once the nonmovant has presented its case.

(Choice D) The standards to grant a motion for summary judgment are identical to those required for a judgment on the pleadings, but a court can consider materials outside the pleadings (eg, discovery materials). Since the dressmaker seeks a resolution based solely on the pleadings, a judgment on the pleadings is more appropriate.

📌 Educational Objective

A party may move for judgment on the pleadings once the pleadings are closed. In considering such a motion, the court is limited to the contents of the pleadings (including exhibits) and matters of public record.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(c) (motion for judgment on the pleadings).
  • 61A Am. Jur. 2d Pleading § 560 (2019) (explaining the requirements for judgment on the pleadings).
questions.zh-question:
一家精品店因违约向联邦法院起诉了一名裁缝。精品店的起诉状指称，该裁缝交付了错误的服装，违反了双方之间的合同。该裁缝立即提交了答辩状，承认其交付了错误的服装。该答辩状还包含一项积极抗辩，即精品店未在适用的诉讼时效内提交起诉状。

该裁缝希望法院仅根据起诉状和答辩状中所含的信息对案件作出裁决。

哪项动议最能实现该裁缝的目标？

zh-choices.A: 一项缺席判决的动议。
zh-choices.B: 一项依法作出判决的动议。
zh-choices.C: 一项基于诉状的判决动议。
zh-choices.D: 一项即决判决的动议。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：审前动议

正确答案：C
一项基于诉状的判决动议
(A motion for judgment on the pleadings)

1. 核心法律依据：FRCP 12(c)

本题考察的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, FRCP) 第 12(c) 条。该规则规定：

规则要点：
  • 时间点： 在诉答程序终结后（After the pleadings are closed），但在不延误审判的情况下提出。
  • 依据范围： 法院仅根据诉状（Pleadings，即起诉状 Complaint 和答辩状 Answer）及所附证物和公共记录进行裁决。
  • 适用情形： 当案件不存在实质性事实争议（Material issue of fact），仅剩法律问题需要解决时。

2. 案情逻辑分析

在本案中，裁缝（被告）想要达成两个目标：

  1. 依据来源限制： 仅基于起诉状和答辩状（Solely on the information contained in the complaint and answer）。
  2. 案件阶段： 答辩状（Answer）已经提交，意味着诉答程序已经关闭。

为何选 C？
被告在答辩状中承认了事实（交付错误服装），但提出了诉讼时效（Statute of Limitations）这一法律抗辩。如果诉讼时效确实已过，那么无论原告的事实多么确凿，法律上都无法胜诉。此时不需要进行证据开示（Discovery），法院仅凭双方提交的文书即可依法作出判决。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

动议类型 错误原因
缺席判决
(Default Judgment)		 被告已经出庭并提交了答辩状，不符合“缺席”条件。
即决判决
(Summary Judgment)		 虽然标准相似，但即决判决通常涉及诉状之外的证据（如宣誓书 Affidavits、取证记录 Depositions）。题目明确要求“仅基于诉状”。
依法判决
(JMOL)		 这是在庭审期间（Trial）提出的动议（FRCP 50），本案尚处于审前阶段。

4. MBE 考场实战技巧

💡 关键词定位法：

当你在题干中看到以下组合时，通常指向 Judgment on the Pleadings：

  • "After the answer was filed"（答辩状提交后）
  • "Decide solely on the pleadings"（仅基于诉状）
  • "Admitted the facts but raised a legal defense"（承认事实但提出法律抗辩）

易混淆点提示： 如果题目提到法院考虑了“宣誓书”(Affidavit) 或“证据开示材料”(Discovery materials)，答案通常是 Summary Judgment。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
An artist from State A filed a federal diversity suit in State B against an art collector from State B for conversion. The complaint alleges that the collector stole a painting from the artist 50 years ago and requests a jury trial on this issue. The statute of limitations for conversion, measured from the time the plaintiff learns that the defendant possesses the property at issue, is 25 years in State A and 10 years in State B.
During discovery, the collector deposed the artist. At her deposition, the artist stated that she knew that the collector had purchased the painting 20 years ago at an auction, but she did not try to recover the painting at that time because she did not want the hassle of a court case to distract her from creating art. However, due to her advancing age, she now seeks to reclaim her painting.
The collector immediately moved for summary judgment. The collector stipulated to all of the facts alleged by the artist at her deposition and attached a transcript of her deposition testimony to the motion. The artist did not respond.
Is the federal court likely to grant the collector's motion?

choices.A: No, because the collector failed to attach an affidavit to the motion.
choices.B: No, because the statute of limitations has not expired.
choices.C: Yes, because the artist did not respond to the motion.
choices.D: Yes, because the collector is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

questions.explanation:
Motion for summary judgment
(FRCP 56)
Time to file
  • Motion may be filed until 30 days after close of discovery OR time set by local rule or court
Burden of
proof
  • Movant has initial burden to establish standard
    • may support by relying on pleadings, affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible facts
  • If initial burden is met, burden shifts to nonmovant to either:
    • show specific disputed facts through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible facts (cannot rely on pleadings) or
    • request postponement for additional discovery & support with affidavit or declaration
Standard for
grant
  • No genuine dispute as to any material fact AND movant entitled to judgment as a matter of law
    • evidence must be viewed in light most favorable to nonmovant
    • all doubts must be resolved in nonmovant's favor
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A motion for summary judgment is a request that the court enter judgment without a full trial. A court may grant summary judgment if the movant shows that:

  • there is no genuine dispute of material fact and
  • the evidence is legally insufficient for a reasonable jury to find in the nonmovant's favor, so the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

Here, there is no genuine issue of material fact because the collector stipulated to all of the facts alleged by the artist at her deposition. The artist testified that she learned that the collector purchased the painting 20 years ago. Since the federal court must apply the substantive law of the state in which it is located, her claim was filed after State B's 10-year statute of limitations had expired (Choice B). As a result, the collector is entitled to judgment as a matter of law, and the court should grant his motion for summary judgment.

(Choice A) The collector did not need to attach an affidavit to his motion. That is because he can rely on pleadings, discovery materials, and other materials containing admissible facts to support his request for summary judgment.

(Choice C) The artist is not required to respond to the motion since the collector has the burden to prove that he is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

📌 Educational Objective

A court should grant summary judgment if the movant shows that there is no genuine issue of material fact and he/she is entitled to judgment as a matter of law (eg, because the statute of limitations has expired).

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 56 (summary judgment).

一位来自A州的艺术家在B州提起了一项联邦多元管辖权诉讼，控告一位来自B州的艺术品收藏家非法侵占。诉状指称，该收藏家在50年前从该艺术家处盗走了一幅画，并就此问题请求陪审团审判。针对非法侵占的诉讼时效（从原告知晓被告占有争议财产之时起算），在A州为25年，在B州为10年。

在证据开示程序期间，收藏家对艺术家进行了庭外取证。在她的庭外证言中，艺术家陈述说，她20年前就知道该收藏家在一次拍卖会上购买了这幅画，但她当时并未试图索回画作，因为她不想让法庭案件的麻烦分散她创作艺术的精力。然而，由于年事已高，她现在寻求索回她的画作。

收藏家立即动议申请即决判决。收藏家对艺术家在庭外证言中指称的所有事实予以承认，并在动议中附上了她的庭外证词笔录。艺术家未作回应。

联邦法院是否可能批准收藏家的动议？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为收藏家未能在动议中附上宣誓书。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为诉讼时效尚未届满。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为艺术家未对动议作出回应。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为收藏家有权获得作为法律问题的判决。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考题解析

Civil Procedure: Summary Judgment
正确答案：D

本题考察的是联邦民事诉讼中的两个核心考点：即决判决的标准 (Summary Judgment Standard) 和 法律适用 (Choice of Law/Erie Doctrine)。

核心法律逻辑解析
1
法律适用原则 (Erie Doctrine)
本案是基于多元管辖权 (Diversity Jurisdiction) 的联邦诉讼。根据 Erie 原则，联邦法院在审理此类案件时，必须适用所在州（Forum State）的实体法，包括该州的诉讼时效法 (Statute of Limitations)。
法院位于 B 州，因此适用 B 州的诉讼时效：10年。
2
事实认定
原告（艺术家）在庭外证言 (Deposition) 中承认，她在 20年前 就知道被告购买了画作。
3
计算时效
时效从原告知晓时起算。
已过时间 (20年) > B州时效 (10年)。
结论：诉讼请求已过时效 (Time-barred)。
即决判决 (Summary Judgment)
规则 (FRCP 56)： 如果动议人表明没有“重大事实的真实争议” (No genuine dispute as to any material fact)，且动议人有权获得“作为法律问题的判决” (Judgment as a matter of law)，法院应批准动议。

在本案中：

  • 无事实争议： 被告直接承认（Stipulated）了原告所述的所有事实。
  • 法律后果明确： 基于承认的事实，根据 B 州法律，原告的诉讼已过时效。被告在法律上有权胜诉。

因此，法院必须批准即决判决，选项 D 正确。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (错误)：关于宣誓书 (Affidavit)

FRCP 56 并不强制要求必须附上宣誓书。动议可以依赖庭外证言录音/笔录 (Deposition transcripts)、答复 (Interrogatory answers) 等证据开示材料。本案中附上的证词笔录已足够。

选项 B (错误)：关于时效未过

该选项错误地适用了 A 州的法律（25年时效）。联邦法院应适用所在州（B 州）的法律。

选项 C (错误)：关于未回应

虽然原告未回应很糟糕，但这并不是法院批准动议的法律依据。法院批准是因为被告尽到了举证责任（证明案件已过时效），而不是单纯因为原告缺席。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
遇到涉及“联邦法院 + 州法索赔”的题目时，首先检查诉讼时效 (Statute of Limitations)。

通常规则是：联邦法院适用所在州的诉讼时效。如果题目给出了两个州的时效，一定要选法院所在地（Forum State）的那个进行计算。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A construction worker sued an insulation manufacturer in federal court, claiming that he had developed a chronic health condition as a result of 20 years of exposure to the manufacturer's insulation at his work sites. The manufacturer answered, denying all liability and stating that it had never supplied its insulation to the worker's employer.
The worker's attorney deposed the manufacturer's president, and the manufacturer's attorney deposed the worker. Immediately thereafter, the manufacturer moved for summary judgment on the ground that the worker had no evidence showing that the insulation had ever been used by the worker's employer.
What would be the worker's best response to the motion for summary judgment?

choices.A: Argue that more time is needed for additional discovery to show the manufacturer's liability, and attach a declaration describing the desired discovery.
choices.B: Argue that the motion should be denied, because a central issue in the case will be the manufacturer's credibility on the question of its distribution of the insulation, and only a jury can decide questions of credibility.
choices.C: Argue that the motion should be denied, because the manufacturer failed to attach any evidence to its motion to show that the insulation was not used by the worker's employer.
choices.D: Make a cross-motion for summary judgment arguing that the manufacturer has introduced no evidence to show that its insulation did not harm the worker.

questions.explanation:
A motion for summary judgment requests that the court enter judgment without a full trial because (1) there is no genuine dispute of material fact and (2) the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

The movant can meet this burden by asserting that the nonmovant lacks evidentiary support for any issue that the nonmovant has the burden to prove—eg, no evidence that the manufacturer's insulation had been used by the worker's employer. If this occurs, the nonmovant can avoid summary judgment by either:

  • presenting evidence to support that issue through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible evidence or
  • requesting that the court postpone consideration of the motion until additional discovery can take place and including an affidavit or declaration that describes the desired discovery and why it is needed.

Since the manufacturer moved for summary judgment after only two depositions, the worker likely needs additional discovery to obtain evidence showing that its employer had used the manufacturer's insulation. Therefore, the worker should argue that more time is needed for additional discovery and attach a declaration or affidavit describing the desired discovery.

(Choice B) Although the manufacturer's credibility will be an important issue at trial, a court never considers the credibility of evidence when making a summary judgment determination. Instead, it will assume that the manufacturer's no-evidence assertion is true unless the worker (nonmovant) presents evidence creating a genuine dispute of material fact. That evidence will then be viewed in the light most favorable to the worker.

(Choices C & D) Since the worker has the burden to prove that the insulation was used by his employer and harmed him, the manufacturer is not required to provide evidence negating these assertions. It need only claim that the worker lacks evidence to support those elements of his claim.

📌 Educational Objective

After receiving a motion for summary judgment, the nonmovant can request that the court postpone considering it until additional discovery can take place. This request must include an affidavit or declaration specifying why the evidence has not been obtained and describing the desired discovery.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 56 (summary judgment).
  • Celotex Corp. v. Catrett, 477 U.S. 317, 323–24 (1986) (explaining when summary judgment is proper).
questions.zh-question:
一名建筑工人在联邦法院起诉了一家保温材料制造商，声称由于在工作场所接触该制造商的保温材料长达20年，他患上了一种慢性健康问题。制造商作出答辩，否认所有责任，并声称其从未向该工人的雇主供应过其保温材料。

工人的律师对制造商的总裁进行了取证质询（depose），制造商的律师也对工人进行了取证质询。紧接着，制造商以工人没有证据证明其雇主曾使用过该保温材料为由，提出了即决判决（summary judgment）的动议。

对于该即决判决动议，工人的最佳回应是什么？

zh-choices.A: 主张需要更多时间进行补充证据开示（discovery），以证明制造商的责任，并附上一份说明所期望的证据开示内容的声明书。
zh-choices.B: 主张该动议应被驳回，因为案件的一个核心问题将是制造商在其保温材料分销问题上的可信度，而只有陪审团才能决定可信度问题。
zh-choices.C: 主张该动议应被驳回，因为制造商在其动议中未能附上任何证据来证明工人的雇主未使用该保温材料。
zh-choices.D: 提出反向即决判决动议（cross-motion for summary judgment），主张制造商未提出任何证据证明其保温材料没有对工人造成伤害。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Summary Judgment

FRCP 56(d) Evidence Discovery
核心考点：补充证据开示请求 当非动议方（Nonmovant）因正当理由无法提供必要事实来反驳即决判决（Summary Judgment）动议时，根据 FRCP 56(d)，法院可以推迟裁决或驳回动议，允许进行更多的证据开示（Discovery）。
✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 A)

本题的关键在于时机（Timing）和程序（Procedure）。

  • 背景：案件刚开始，仅进行了两次口头取证（Deposition），制造商就立即提出了即决判决动议。
  • 困境：原告（工人）负有举证责任，证明雇主使用了该制造商的产品。制造商指出原告目前“没有证据”（No evidence）。
  • 解决方案：虽然制造商的动议在技术上是允许的（指出原告缺乏证据），但原告可以通过提交一份宣誓书或声明（Affidavit or Declaration），说明为了证明事实还需要进行哪些具体的证据开示（如获取运输记录、发票等）。

因此，选项 A 是最佳策略：它直接引用了 FRCP 56(d) 的救济机制，要求法院给予更多时间来收集证据。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B (Credibility):
虽然陪审团确实负责判断可信度，但在即决判决阶段，如果原告拿不出任何实质性证据（Evidence）来反驳被告的“无证据”主张，法院无法仅凭“被告可能在撒谎”这一理论就让案件进入审判。原告必须先展示存在事实争议（Genuine Dispute of Material Fact）。
选项 C (Burden of Proof):
这是一个常见的误区。根据 Celotex Corp. v. Catrett 判例，动议方（被告）不需要提供证据证明自己无责；如果举证责任在原告，被告只需指出原告缺乏证据支持其主张即可。
选项 D (Cross-motion):
提出反向动议是自杀行为。因为原告负有举证责任，如果原告自己都拿不出证据证明因果关系，法院更不可能判原告直接胜诉。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Strategy)

在 MBE 民事诉讼题中，如果看到一方在证据开示早期（Early Discovery）就提出即决判决动议，且理由是对方“缺乏证据”：

  1. 首先判断非动议方是否真的没有机会收集证据。
  2. 如果是，正确答案通常涉及 FRCP 56(d)：请求延期并提交声明书（Affidavit/Declaration）说明需要的证据。
  3. 记住：仅仅抱怨“不公平”或“需要陪审团”通常不足以在程序上击败即决判决动议。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A plaintiff has brought a federal diversity action against a defendant, alleging that the defendant defamed and inflicted emotional distress on the plaintiff. The plaintiff had the summons and complaint delivered to the defendant's home by the plaintiff's 18-year-old nephew. The nephew handed the documents to the defendant's 16-year-old daughter who resides there. She placed the documents on the kitchen table, and the defendant reviewed those documents later that week. After reading the complaint, the defendant could not determine what conduct the plaintiff was claiming had caused the emotional distress.
What is the defendant's best response to the plaintiff's complaint?

choices.A: File a motion for a more definite statement.
choices.B: File a motion for judgment on the pleadings.
choices.C: File a motion to dismiss for improper service of process.
choices.D: File a motion to strike the emotional distress claim.

questions.explanation:
FRCP 12 motions
12(b) Motion asserting any of the following defenses:
  • Lack of subject-matter or personal jurisdiction
  • Improper venue
  • Insufficient process or service of process
  • Failure to state claim upon which relief can be granted
  • Failure to join required party
12(c) Motion for judgment on the pleadings
12(e) Motion for more definite statement in pleading
12(f) Motion to strike insufficient defense or immaterial matter from pleading
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

When a party believes that a pleading (eg, complaint) is so vague or ambiguous that the party cannot reasonably draft a response, the party should file an FRCP 12(e) motion for a more definite statement. If the court grants this motion because the pleading lacks the requisite specificity, the nonmovant must provide a more definite statement (eg, amended complaint) that will allow the movant to file a responsive pleading (eg, answer).

Here, the defendant could not determine what conduct the plaintiff was claiming had caused the emotional distress. Therefore, a motion for a more definite statement is the defendant's best response to the plaintiff's unclear complaint.

(Choice B) Under FRCP 12(c), a party may move for a judgment on the pleadings after the pleadings have closed—ie, once the plaintiff's complaint and the defendant's answer have been served. Since the defendant has not yet served an answer, a motion for judgment on the pleadings would be improper.

(Choice C) An individual can be served with process if the summons and complaint are delivered to the individual's dwelling and left with a resident of suitable age and discretion (16-year-old daughter). Process can be served by any person who is at least 18 years old and not a party to the suit (18-year-old nephew). As a result, a motion to dismiss for improper service of process would be unsuccessful.

(Choice D) A party may move to strike an insufficient defense or any redundant, scandalous, impertinent, or immaterial matter from an opposing party's pleading under FRCP 12(f). Since the plaintiff's complaint contains none of these matters, a motion to strike the emotional distress claim would not be the defendant's best response.

📌 Educational Objective

A party should move for a more definite statement when a pleading is so vague or ambiguous that the party cannot reasonably draft a responsive pleading.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(e) (motion for a more definite statement).
questions.zh-question:
一名原告对一名被告提起了联邦多元管辖权诉讼，指控被告诽谤原告并对其造成了精神损害。

原告让其18岁的侄子将传票和诉状送至被告家中。该侄子将文件交给了居住在那里的被告16岁的女儿。她将文件放在厨房餐桌上，被告于当周晚些时候审阅了这些文件。在阅读诉状后，被告无法确定原告所声称的造成其精神损害的具体行为是什么。

对于原告的诉状，被告的最佳应对策略是什么？

zh-choices.A: 提出要求更明确陈述的动议。
zh-choices.B: 提出基于诉状的判决动议。
zh-choices.C: 以送达程序不当为由提出驳回动议。
zh-choices.D: 提出删除精神损害诉求的动议。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

联邦民事诉讼规则 (FRCP) - 动议
✅ 正确答案：A 提出要求更明确陈述的动议
(File a motion for a more definite statement)

本题的核心考点在于：当被告收到一份过于模糊以至于无法进行有效答辩的诉状时，应该采取什么程序性措施。

⚖️ 法律依据：FRCP 12(e)
Motion for a More Definite Statement

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第12(e)条，如果一份诉状（Pleading）过于模糊或含糊不清 (vague or ambiguous)，以至于对方当事人无法合理地起草回应性诉状（Responsive Pleading），当事人可以申请要求更明确的陈述。

案情分析：

  • 被告阅读了诉状，知道原告指控了“精神损害”。
  • 但是，被告无法确定是哪种具体行为导致了这种损害。
  • 如果没有具体的行为描述，被告就无法承认或否认指控，也无法提出针对性的抗辩。
  • 因此，这符合 FRCP 12(e) 的适用条件。
🚫 为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 C 错误：送达程序不当

这是本题最大的干扰项。根据 FRCP 4(e)(2)(B)，替代送达 (Substituted Service) 是有效的，只要满足：

  1. 送达至个人的住所 (Dwelling/House)；
  2. 留给居住在那里的适龄且具有判断力的人 (Person of suitable age and discretion)。

本案中：16岁的女儿居住在被告家中，且通常被认为具备适当的年龄和判断力。送达人是18岁的非当事人（侄子），符合要求。因此，送达是合法的，驳回动议不会成功。

选项 B 错误：基于诉状的判决

Motion for Judgment on the Pleadings (FRCP 12(c)) 必须在“诉状程序结束”后（即 Complaint 和 Answer 都提交后）才能提出。本案中被告尚未提交答辩状 (Answer)，因此为时过早。

选项 D 错误：删除动议

Motion to Strike (FRCP 12(f)) 用于删除冗余、诽谤性、无礼或无关紧要的内容。仅仅因为指控“模糊不清”，并不构成删除的理由。

📊 考点总结：FRCP 12条动议速查
规则 动议类型 适用场景
12(b) 驳回动议
(Motion to Dismiss)		 管辖权、送达、未能陈述请求等致命缺陷。
12(c) 基于诉状判决
(Judgment on Pleadings)		 双方均已提交诉状，仅凭文件即可判决。
12(e) 更明确陈述
(More Definite Statement)		 诉状太模糊，无法写答辩状。
12(f) 删除动议
(Motion to Strike)		 诉状中包含诽谤、无关或冗余信息。
💡 MBE 答题技巧：
如果在题干中看到被告“无法理解”或“不知道如何回应”具体的指控细节，首先考虑 12(e)。如果题干强调送达给了家里的其他人，请检查该人是否“居住在此”以及是否“适龄”。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A plaintiff brought a diversity action in a federal district court and served process on the defendant. After thoroughly reviewing the plaintiff's complaint, the defendant's attorney could not reasonably identify the grounds upon which the plaintiff's claims for relief rest. The defendant's attorney moved for a more definite statement, and the court ordered the plaintiff's attorney to file a more definite statement.
What should the plaintiff's attorney do?

choices.A: File a reply within 21 days.
choices.B: File a supplemental complaint within 14 days.
choices.C: File an amended complaint within 14 days.
choices.D: File an answer within 21 days.

questions.explanation:
Motion for more definite statement
(FRCP 12(e))
Request Motion must:
• specify pleading's defects & details needed to cure defects and
• be made before filing responsive pleading (eg, answer)
Response Defect must be cured:
• by filing amended pleading within 14 days after court order granting motion
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A party should file a motion for a more definite statement of a pleading (eg, complaint) if the pleading is so vague or ambiguous that the party cannot reasonably prepare a responsive pleading (eg, answer). Here, the defendant's attorney could not reasonably identify the grounds upon which the plaintiff's claims for relief rest after thoroughly reviewing the complaint. Therefore, a motion for a more definite statement was appropriate.

When the court grants such a motion, the nonmovant must provide a more definite statement in an amended pleading within 14 days after receiving notice of the order or a time otherwise set by the court. Failure to do so allows the court to strike the pleading or issue another appropriate order. Therefore, the plaintiff's attorney should file an amended complaint within 14 days of the court order.

(Choice A) A reply is a response to an answer that is made only when the court orders it. If the court orders a reply, the party must serve it within 21 days after being served with the court order (unless the order states otherwise). Here, the plaintiff cannot file a reply since the defendant has not yet filed an answer and no court order authorizes a reply.

(Choice B) A supplemental pleading (eg, supplemental complaint) sets forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after the pleading to be supplemented was filed. Conversely, an amended pleading sets forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose before the pleading to be amended was filed (as seen here).

(Choice D) An answer is a pleading that addresses the merits of the dispute and presents defenses and counterclaims. This pleading is appropriate only in response to a plaintiff's complaint or a defendant's counterclaim. Since neither is being responded to here, the plaintiff cannot file an answer.

📌 Educational Objective

When a court grants a motion for a more definite statement, the nonmovant must provide a more definite statement in an amended pleading within 14 days after receiving notice of the order or a time otherwise set by the court.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(e) (motion for a more definite statement).
  • 5C Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 1379 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining that the nonmovant must file an amended pleading within 14 days after a court orders a more definite statement).
questions.zh-question:
一名原告向联邦地区法院提起了多元管辖诉讼，并向被告送达了法律文书。在仔细审阅原告的诉状后，被告律师无法合理地确定原告请求救济所依据的理由。被告律师动议要求更明确的陈述，法院命令原告律师提交一份更明确的陈述。

原告律师应该怎么做？

zh-choices.A: 在21天内提交回复。
zh-choices.B: 在14天内提交补充诉状。
zh-choices.C: 在14天内提交修改后的诉状。
zh-choices.D: 在21天内提交答辩状。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：民事诉讼程序

FRCP 12(e) - Motion for More Definite Statement
正确答案：C 原告律师应在 14天内 提交 修改后的诉状 (Amended Complaint)。
法律依据与推理

本题考查的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第12(e)条关于要求更明确陈述的动议 (Motion for a More Definite Statement) 的程序规则。

规则核心 (FRCP 12(e))：
如果诉状（Pleading）含糊不清或模棱两可，导致对方无法合理地准备回应性文书，对方可以提出此动议。

关键时间点与行动：

  • 一旦法院批准 (Grants) 该动议，原告必须纠正诉状中的缺陷。
  • 纠正方式： 提交一份修改后的诉状 (Amended Complaint)，将原本模糊的内容阐述清楚。
  • 时限： 除非法院另有规定，否则必须在收到法院命令通知后的 14天 (14 days) 内提交。

如果原告未能在14天内遵守该命令，法院有权撤销 (Strike) 该诉状或发布其他适当的命令。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A (Reply) 错误：
回复 (Reply) 通常是针对被告的答辩状 (Answer) 提出的。本案中被告尚未提交答辩状，且除非法院特别命令，否则原告无需提交回复。
选项 B (Supplemental Complaint) 错误：
这是一个常见的混淆点。
  • 修改 (Amended)： 针对原诉状提交之前已经发生的事实进行更正或澄清（本题情况）。
  • 补充 (Supplemental)： 针对原诉状提交之后新发生的交易、事件或事由。
本题是澄清原有的模糊指控，而非添加新事件，因此应使用 Amended Complaint。
选项 D (Answer) 错误：
答辩状 (Answer) 是被告针对原告起诉的回应，或者是原告针对反诉 (Counterclaim) 的回应。原告不会针对自己的起诉提交答辩状。
🎓 备考小贴士：
在 MBE 考试中，遇到 FRCP 12(e) 动议被批准的情况，请牢记两个关键词：
1. Amended Pleading（修改性诉状，而非补充性诉状）
2. 14 Days（14天时限，而非21天）
MBE Civil Procedure Review

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A group of parents sued a public school district in a federal district court to enjoin the school district from using public funds and resources for educational programs at religious schools. The judge presiding over the case concluded that the programs violated the establishment clause and issued a permanent injunction against the school to prevent it from continuing with these programs.
Twenty years later, the school district filed a motion in the federal district court to obtain relief from the injunction. The school district argued that establishment clause law had changed so significantly that the programs are now constitutional.
May the court consider this motion?

choices.A: No, because only an appellate court may provide relief from the judgment.
choices.B: No, because the motion was not filed within one year from the entry of final judgment.
choices.C: Yes, because the motion concerns a constitutional issue.
choices.D: Yes, because the motion concerns law that may have significantly changed.

questions.explanation:
Relief from final judgment
(FRCP 60(b))
Grounds for relief Time to file
1. Mistake, inadvertence, surprise, excusable neglect
2. Newly discovered evidence
3. Fraud, misrepresentation, misconduct 		Within one year
4. Void judgment (eg, lack of jurisdiction)
5. Judgment:
• satisfied, released, discharged
• based on reversed or vacated judgment or
• will violate equity if applied prospectively
6. Other reason justifying relief (rare) 		Within reasonable time

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 60(b), a party may move for extraordinary relief from a court's final judgment or order on limited grounds. The motion must be made within one year from the court's judgment for any of the following reasons:

1. The judgment was based on the parties or the court's mistake, inadvertence, surprise, or excusable neglect.

2. The moving party discovered new evidence.

3. An opposing party engaged in fraud, misrepresentation, or misconduct.

All other FRCP 60(b) motions can be made within a reasonable time under the circumstances. This includes FRCP 60(b)(5), which authorizes relief from a judgment that:

• has been satisfied, released, or discharged

• is based on an earlier judgment that has been reversed or vacated or

• will violate equity if applied prospectively.

In Agostini v. Felton, the Supreme Court held that it violates equity to prospectively apply a judgment that was based on facts or law that have significantly changed since the court issued it. The school district's motion for relief challenges the permanent injunction on this ground, so the one-year deadline does not apply. And the motion was made within a reasonable time because the school district needed to wait until the law had significantly changed before requesting relief. As a result, the court may consider the school district's motion (Choice B).

(Choice A) An appellate court may only provide relief from a judgment under FRCP 60(b) after a district court has entered a final order pertaining to such relief, which has yet to occur here.

(Choice C) The mere fact that the motion concerns a constitutional issue (ie, the establishment clause) does not provide a basis to consider this motion for relief.

📌 Educational Objective

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 60(b)(5), a party may file a motion within a reasonable time to obtain relief from a judgment that (1) has been satisfied, released, or discharged, (2) is based on an earlier judgment that has been reversed or vacated, or (3) will violate equity if applied prospectively.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 60(b)–(c) (relief from judgment).
  • Agostini v. Felton, 521 U.S. 203, 237 (1997) (holding that it is inequitable to prospectively apply an injunction that is based on law that has significantly changed since the injunction was issued).
questions.zh-question:
一群家长在联邦地区法院起诉一个公立学区，请求禁止该学区使用公共资金和资源在宗教学校开展教育项目。主审此案的法官认定，这些项目违反了《政教分离条款》，并对学校发出了永久性禁令，以阻止其继续实施这些项目。

二十年后，该学区向联邦地区法院提出动议，请求解除该禁令。该学区辩称，《政教分离条款》的相关法律已发生重大变化，因此这些项目现在是合宪的。

法院可以审理此动议吗？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为只有上诉法院才能对判决提供救济。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为该动议未在最终判决作出后的一年内提出。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为该动议涉及一个宪法问题。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为该动议涉及可能已发生重大变化的法律。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：判决后的救济

本题考察的核心知识点是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第60(b)条 (FRCP 60(b))，即关于解除或修改最终判决（Relief from Final Judgment）的规则。

正确答案：D
法院可以审理此动议，因为法律的重大变化可能导致继续执行原禁令不再公平。

1. 核心规则：FRCP 60(b) 的时限与理由

FRCP 60(b) 允许法院在特定情况下解除最终判决。考生必须区分两类不同的时限要求：

理由 (Grounds) 时限 (Timing)
1. 错误、疏忽 (Mistake/Excusable Neglect)
2. 新证据 (Newly Discovered Evidence)
3. 欺诈 (Fraud) 		严格限制在1年内
(Strictly within 1 year)
4. 判决无效 (Void Judgment)
5. 判决已履行或不再公平 (Inequitable Prospective Application)
6. 其他特殊理由 		合理时间内
(Within a reasonable time)

2. 为什么本题不受“1年时限”限制？

本题的情况属于表格中的第5类（FRCP 60(b)(5)）。

当一个判决是禁令 (Injunction) 时，它具有“前瞻性” (Prospective application)。如果法律发生了重大变化，导致原本违宪的行为现在变得合宪了，那么继续强制执行旧的禁令就会变得“不公平” (Inequitable)。

判例背景：Agostini v. Felton (1997)
本题改编自该著名判例。最高法院裁定，当作为禁令基础的法律（Establishment Clause law）发生重大变化时，继续执行旧禁令违反衡平法原则。因此，即使过了20年，只要是在法律变更后的“合理时间”内提出，法院仍可受理。

3. 选项辨析

  • 选项 A 错误：地区法院（District Court）拥有对自己发出的禁令进行修改或解除的管辖权，不需要非得去上诉法院。FRCP 60(b) 动议是向作出判决的法院提出的。
  • 选项 B 错误（常见陷阱）：这是最强的干扰项。考生容易死记“1年规则”。但如上表所示，涉及“前瞻性公平” (Prospective Equity) 的动议不受1年限制，只需在“合理时间”内提出即可。
  • 选项 C 错误：仅仅因为涉及“宪法问题”并不是法院重新审理已结案案件的理由。必须符合 FRCP 60(b) 的具体法定理由（如法律变更导致执行不公）。
  • 选项 D 正确：法律的重大变化使得继续执行禁令变得不公平，这正是 FRCP 60(b)(5) 允许救济的典型情形。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“Motion for Relief from Judgment”时，第一步先看理由是什么。如果是“律师忘了提交文件”或“发现了新证人”，死扣1年时限。如果是“禁令”且“法律/事实变了”，则适用合理时间标准，通常不受年份限制。

questions.topic: Alteration of or Relief of a Judgment
questions.question:
A driver from State A and a bicyclist from State B were involved in a collision that caused the driver to incur $150,000 in medical expenses. The driver filed a federal diversity action in State B based on negligence. The summons and complaint were served at the bicyclist's home, where the process server handed the documents to the bicyclist's 16-year-old daughter. The daughter failed to share those documents with the bicyclist who, unbeknownst to the driver, was in a coma. No one else was informed about the lawsuit.
After three months, no response had been filed so the clerk entered the bicyclist's default into the record. The court then entered a default judgment in favor of the driver.
Ten months after the entry of default judgment, the bicyclist awoke from the coma and learned about the default judgment. The bicyclist immediately hired a lawyer who filed a motion to set aside the default judgment based on excusable neglect. An affidavit from an eyewitness to the accident, who stated that the bicyclist did not swerve into the driver's lane as the driver claimed, was attached to the motion.
Is the court likely to grant the bicyclist's motion?

choices.A: No, because more than one year has passed since the driver filed his complaint.
choices.B: No, because the driver did not engage in misconduct.
choices.C: Yes, because service of process was improper.
choices.D: Yes, because the attached affidavit provides a meritorious defense.

questions.explanation:
Relief from final judgment
(FRCP 60(b))
Grounds for relief Time to file
1. Mistake, inadvertence, surprise, excusable neglect
2. Newly discovered evidence
3. Fraud, misrepresentation, misconduct 		Within one year
4. Void judgment (eg, lack of jurisdiction)
5. Judgment:
• satisfied, released, discharged
• based on reversed or vacated judgment or
• will violate equity if applied prospectively
6. Other reason justifying relief (rare) 		Within reasonable
time
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A default judgment is a final judgment that is entered when the defendant has failed to timely serve an answer. A party can move for extraordinary relief from a default judgment (or any other final judgment) in limited circumstances. The motion must typically be filed within a reasonable time, but it must be filed within one year from the entry of judgment when asserting any of the following grounds for relief:

  1. The judgment was due to the court's or party's mistake, inadvertence, surprise, or excusable neglect.
  2. The movant discovered new evidence.
  3. The nonmovant engaged in misrepresentation, misconduct, or fraud.

A motion based on mistake, inadvertence, surprise, or excusable neglect will be granted if the movant also demonstrates a meritorious defense.

Here, the bicyclist's failure to timely serve an answer was excusable because he was in a coma. And the affidavit attached to the bicyclist's motion provides a meritorious defense. That is because the eyewitness statement challenges the substance of the driver's claim (rather than merely raising a technical or procedural issue). Therefore, the court will likely grant the bicyclist's motion to set aside the default judgment.

(Choice A) A motion for extraordinary relief based on excusable neglect must be made within one year after the judgment was entered—not after the complaint was filed.

(Choice B) The driver did not engage in misconduct since he was unaware that the bicyclist was in a coma. However, the bicyclist may still obtain relief since his failure to file a timely answer was excusable.

(Choice C) Service of process is proper if it is delivered to the defendant's dwelling and left with a resident of suitable age and discretion. Most teenagers are of suitable age and discretion since they possess the limited capacity necessary to comprehend the situation. Therefore, service of process on the bicyclist's 16-year-old daughter was proper.

📌 Educational Objective

A motion for extraordinary relief from a final judgment (eg, default judgment) based on mistake, inadvertence, surprise, or excusable neglect will be granted if the movant demonstrates a meritorious defense.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 60(b)–(c) (extraordinary relief from judgment).
  • 47 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 663 (2019) (meritorious-defense requirement).

一名来自A州的司机和一名来自B州的骑行者卷入了一场碰撞事故，导致该司机产生了15万美元的医疗费用。该司机以过失为由，在B州提起了联邦多元管辖权诉讼。传票和诉状在骑行者的家中送达，送达人将文件交给了骑行者16岁的女儿。女儿未能将这些文件告知骑行者，而司机并不知道，骑行者当时正处于昏迷状态。没有其他人被告知此诉讼。

三个月后，由于没有提交任何答复，书记官将骑行者的缺席记录在案。法院随后作出了有利于司机的缺席判决。

在缺席判决作出十个月后，骑行者从昏迷中醒来，并得知了该缺席判决。骑行者立即聘请了一名律师，以“可原谅的疏忽”为由，提起了撤销缺席判决的动议。动议中附有一份来自事故目击者的宣誓书，该宣誓书称，骑行者并未如司机所声称的那样，突然转向并驶入司机车道。

法院是否可能批准骑行者的动议？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为自司机提起诉状以来已经超过一年。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为司机没有不当行为。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为诉讼文书的送达不当。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为所附的宣誓书提供了有理据的抗辩。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Relief from Judgment
核心规则：FRCP 60(b)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第60(b)条，法院可以在以下情况下解除终局判决（包括缺席判决）：

  • 理由：错误、疏忽、意外或可原谅的疏忽 (Excusable Neglect)。
  • 时效：必须在判决作出后一年内提出动议。
  • 前提：动议人通常需要证明自己拥有有理据的抗辩 (Meritorious Defense)。

为什么选 D？

本题考察的是法院是否会基于“可原谅的疏忽”撤销缺席判决。法院倾向于根据案件的是非曲直（Merits）而非技术性违规来审理案件。

  • 存在可原谅的疏忽：
    被告处于昏迷状态 (Coma) 且不知情，这是无法回应诉讼的极端正当理由。
  • 符合时效要求：
    动议是在缺席判决作出后10个月提出的，未超过1年的限制。
  • 关键点：有理据的抗辩 (Meritorious Defense)：
    仅仅有借口是不够的，被告还必须证明如果重审，他有胜诉的可能性。题目中提到的宣誓书 (Affidavit) 提供了目击证词，反驳了原告的过失主张。这构成了一个有效的实质性抗辩。

因此，法院很可能会批准该动议，给被告一个辩护的机会。

常见误区与陷阱

❌ 选项 A (时效计算错误)

FRCP 60(b) 的一年时效是从判决作出 (Entry of Judgment) 时开始计算，而不是从提起诉讼 (Filing of Complaint) 时开始。本案中，判决后仅过了10个月。

❌ 选项 B (原告无过错)

撤销判决不一定需要原告有不当行为 (Misconduct)。虽然原告不知道被告昏迷，但这不影响被告基于自身“可原谅的疏忽”寻求救济的权利。

❌ 选项 C (送达程序)

这是一个经典的 MBE 干扰项。根据 FRCP 4(e)(2)(B)，将传票留在被告住所，并交给适龄且具有判断力 (Suitable age and discretion) 的居住者是有效的。
考点提示：通常认为16岁的青少年具备这种能力，因此送达是合法的 (Proper)。

🎓 MBE 实战技巧

在处理 Default Judgment 问题时，请遵循两步走：

  1. 程序是否合法？ (送达是否有效？法院是否有管辖权？)
  2. 是否有理由撤销？ (如果是 Excusable Neglect，必须同时寻找 Meritorious Defense)。

如果题目中特意提到了“附带了宣誓书证明被告没有过错”，这通常是在暗示你法院会倾向于撤销判决。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
An actor brought a federal diversity action against a theater company for breach of contract. Twenty days after discovery closed, the company moved for summary judgment. The company attached to the motion affidavits of its managing director and artistic director and a verified copy of its contract with the actor. In their affidavits, the directors stated facts establishing that the company had fully performed the contract.
The actor's brief opposing the motion relied solely on the allegations of the complaint.
Should the court grant the summary-judgment motion?

choices.A: No, because in deciding the motion, the court must take the allegations and inferences of the complaint as true.
choices.B: No, because the company did not timely file the motion.
choices.C: Yes, because the actor filed no evidence in opposition to the motion.
choices.D: Yes, because there is no genuine dispute as to any material fact and the company is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

questions.explanation:
Burden of proof for summary judgment
Movant proves:
↓
No genuine dispute of material
fact & entitled to JMOL by:
  • pleadings
  • affidavits/declarations
  • discovery or
  • other materials
↓
Burden shifts to nonmovant
↓
Nonmovant proves either:
Specific disputed facts by:
  • affidavits/declarations
  • discovery or
  • other materials
↓
Summary judgment denied
Additional discovery needed
to establish essential facts by:
  • affidavits/declarations
↓
Consideration of summary
judgment postponed
JMOL = Judgment as a matter of law.

In a summary-judgment motion, the movant has the initial burden to show that there is no genuine dispute of material fact and the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law. The movant must support this motion with admissible facts contained in pleadings, affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials.

Once the movant satisfies its initial burden, the burden shifts to the nonmovant to avoid summary judgment by either:

  • requesting that the court postpone consideration of the motion until additional discovery can take place (not seen here) or
  • showing specific disputed facts through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible evidence, but not through pleadings.

Here, the company supported its summary-judgment motion through its directors' affidavits, which stated facts establishing that the company had fully performed its contract with the actor. The actor then failed to show specific disputed facts because his brief opposing the motion relied solely on allegations in the complaint. This means that there is no genuine dispute of material fact and the company is entitled to judgment as a matter of law. Therefore, the court should grant the company's motion.

(Choice A) In deciding a summary-judgment motion, a court must view the evidence in the light most favorable to the nonmovant. However, a court is not required to take the complaint's allegations and inferences as true.

(Choice B) A summary-judgment motion may be filed at any time until 30 days after the close of discovery. Therefore, the company timely moved for summary judgment 20 days after discovery closed.

(Choice C) The fact that the actor filed no evidence in opposition to the motion is not, by itself, sufficient for the court to grant the motion. Instead, the motion should be granted because the company satisfied its burden.

📌 Educational Objective

The nonmovant can defeat a summary-judgment motion by showing specific disputed facts through affidavits, declarations, discovery, or other materials containing admissible evidence. However, the nonmovant cannot defeat the motion by relying on allegations in the pleadings.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 56 (summary judgment).
  • 10A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2727 (4th ed. 2020) (explaining the burden-shifting process of a motion for summary judgment).
questions.zh-question:
一名演员因合同违约对一家戏剧公司提起联邦多元管辖权诉讼 (federal diversity action)。在证据开示 (discovery) 程序结束后二十天，该公司动议申请即决判决 (summary judgment)。该公司在动议中附上了其总经理和艺术总监的宣誓证词 (affidavits)，以及一份经核实的与该演员的合同副本。在其宣誓证词中，两位总监陈述了事实，证明公司已完全履行了合同。

演员反对该动议的辩护状 (brief) 仅依据其诉状 (complaint) 中的指控。

法院是否应批准该即决判决动议？

zh-choices.A: 不应批准，因为在裁定该动议时，法院必须将诉状中的指控和推论视为真实。
zh-choices.B: 不应批准，因为该公司未及时提交该动议。
zh-choices.C: 应批准，因为演员未提交任何证据来反对该动议。
zh-choices.D: 应批准，因为不存在任何关于重要事实的真实争议 (genuine dispute as to any material fact)，且该公司有权获得法律上的判决 (judgment as a matter of law)。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：即决判决

本题的正确答案是 (D)。

这道题考查的是联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP 56）下 即决判决 (Summary Judgment) 的核心运作机制，特别是关于“举证责任转移” (Burden Shifting) 的规则。

核心法律规则 (FRCP 56):
当动议方 (Movant) 证明案件中不存在“关于重要事实的真实争议” (Genuine dispute as to any material fact) 且其有权获得法律上的判决时，法院应批准即决判决。

⚖️ 逻辑推演步骤

1
动议方的初始责任：
被告（戏剧公司）提交了动议，并附上了宣誓证词 (Affidavits) 和核实后的合同，证明其已完全履行合同。此时，被告已经满足了其初始举证责任，证明了自己没有违约。
2
责任转移 (Burden Shifts)：
一旦动议方提供了证据支持，举证责任就转移到了非动议方（原告演员）。原告必须拿出具体的证据（如反驳的宣誓证词、沉积证词等）来证明存在事实争议。
3
原告的致命错误：
原告仅仅依赖其诉状 (Complaint) 中的指控。在即决判决阶段，仅仅重申诉状中的指控是不够的。原告未能提供任何反驳证据。
4
结论：
由于原告没有提供证据反驳，法院必须依据被告提供的未被反驳的证据（即公司已履约）进行裁决。因此，不存在事实争议，被告胜诉。

🚫 易错点辨析 (Distractors)

陷阱选项 A：关于“视为真实”
选项A混淆了“驳回起诉动议” (Motion to Dismiss, Rule 12(b)(6)) 和“即决判决” (Summary Judgment, Rule 56)。
  • 在 Motion to Dismiss 阶段，法院确实必须假设诉状中的指控为真。
  • 但在 Summary Judgment 阶段，目的是“刺破诉辩状” (Pierce the pleadings) 查看是否有真实证据支持诉讼继续。此时诉状不再被自动视为真实。

选项 B (时间问题)：
根据 FRCP 56(b)，除非地方法规另有规定，当事人可在证据开示 (Discovery) 结束后 30 天内提出即决判决动议。本案中是 20 天，因此是及时的。

选项 C (表述不严谨)：
虽然原告确实没提交证据，但法院批准动议的法律标准是“不存在重要事实争议且动议方有权获得法律判决”（即选项 D 的表述）。选项 C 描述了现象，而 D 描述了法律依据。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 民事诉讼题中，一旦看到一方提交了 Affidavits 或 Discovery materials 支持其动议，而另一方仅仅依赖 Pleadings (Complaint/Answer)，这通常意味着依赖 Pleadings 的一方将败诉。记住口诀："Evidence beats Allegations" (证据胜过指控)。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A plaintiff brought a diversity action against a defendant in federal district court to determine liability in a fatal auto accident. During jury deliberations, a juror brought a highway manual that he had found at the local library into the jury room. The manual listed the skid mark distances created when a vehicle brakes at various speeds. The jurors used the manual's data to analyze the admitted photographic evidence of the skid marks from the accident scene. They determined that the plaintiff must have been traveling at a recklessly high speed, which caused the accident. Based on the data from the highway manual, the jury returned a verdict in favor of the defendant. The judge presiding over the case entered a final judgment consistent with that verdict on the same day. The plaintiff made no posttrial motions and did not file a notice of appeal.
Sixty days after the court entered final judgment, one of the jurors went to the presiding judge's chambers and told her about the highway manual. The juror then told the judge that the data from the highway manual was the primary reason why the jury found in favor of the defendant. The judge was concerned about this revelation and asked her clerk to research whether the court could order a new trial. After extensive research, the clerk determined that the judge may not order a new trial sua sponte in the action.
What is the most likely reason the clerk determined that the judge may not order a new trial sua sponte?

choices.A: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte.
choices.B: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte unless a party engaged in misconduct.
choices.C: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte until an appeal from the judgment is filed.
choices.D: A court may not order a new trial sua sponte when more than 28 days have passed since the entry of final judgment.

A court may order a new trial on its own initiative (ie, sua sponte) only under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 59 (Choice A). A court may do so on any ground that has previously provided a basis for a new trial in federal court. One such ground is when a juror (or a judge, attorney, or party) engaged in prejudicial misconduct.

Here, prejudicial misconduct occurred when a juror brought in, and the jury based its verdict on, evidence outside the record—the highway manual. However, FRCP 59 requires that a court's sua sponte order (or a party's motion) for a new trial be filed within 28 days after entry of the final judgment. Since 60 days have passed since final judgment was entered, this is the most likely reason the judge may not order a new trial sua sponte.

However, a party may still seek relief from final judgment under FRCP 60 if extraordinary circumstances exist and a motion for such relief is made within a reasonable time after the entry of final judgment. Here, the discovery of prejudicial juror misconduct after the deadline for the court to order a new trial had passed would warrant such relief, and the plaintiff may still timely file this motion. Therefore, the plaintiff is not without a remedy.

(Choice B) A court may order a new trial on several grounds—including, but not limited to, when a judge, attorney, party, or juror engaged in prejudicial misconduct.

(Choice C) A court may order a new trial sua sponte before a notice of appeal is filed so long as the order was filed within 28 days after the entry of final judgment.

📌 Educational Objective

A party may move for a new trial—or a court may order a new trial on its own initiative—within 28 days after the entry of final judgment.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 59 (explaining that a court may order a new trial sua sponte within 28 days after a final judgment is entered).
  • Montgomery Ward & Co. v. Duncan, 311 U.S. 243, 251 (1940) (articulating grounds for a new trial).

一名原告在联邦地区法院对一名被告提起了州籍多元之诉（diversity action），以确定一起致命车祸的责任归属。在陪审团审议期间，一名陪审员将他在当地图书馆找到的一本公路手册带入了陪审团室。该手册列出了车辆在不同速度下刹车时产生的刹车痕迹距离。陪审员们使用该手册的数据来分析法庭采纳的事故现场刹车痕迹的照片证据。他们认定原告必定是以鲁莽（recklessly）的高速行驶，从而导致了事故。根据公路手册的数据，陪审团作出了有利于被告的裁决。主审此案的法官在当天作出了与该裁决一致的终局判决。原告没有提出审后动议，也没有提交上诉通知。

在法院作出终局判决六十天后，其中一名陪审员来到主审法官的办公室，告诉了她关于公路手册的事情。该陪审员接着告诉法官，公路手册的数据是陪审团作出有利于被告裁决的主要原因。法官对此披露感到担忧，并要求其书记员研究法院是否可以下令进行新的审判。

法官可以下令进行新的审判吗？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为法官不得依职权（sua sponte）下令进行新的审判。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为在终局判决作出超过28天后，不得批准进行新的审判。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为在对判决的上诉被立案（docketed）前，法院可以批准进行新的审判。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为当有陪审员不当行为的证据时，法院必须下令进行新的审判。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Post-Trial Motions
核心考点：FRCP 59 (New Trial)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP) 第59条，无论是当事人提出动议，还是法院依职权 (sua sponte) 下令，进行新的审判 (New Trial) 的最后期限均为终局判决作出后的 28天 内。

案情关键点分析

本题考察的是法院在没有当事人动议的情况下，是否有权因陪审员不当行为 (Juror Misconduct) 下令重审，以及该权力的时间限制。

  • 事件：陪审员引入外部证据（公路手册），导致裁决不公。
  • 时间轴：终局判决 (Final Judgment) 已作出 60天。
  • 法官意图：依职权 (sua sponte) 下令重审。
为什么选 B？

答案：不可以，因为时间已过。

虽然陪审员的不当行为（引入庭外证据）确实是批准新审判的有效理由，但程序性规则（时效）优先于实体理由。

FRCP 59(d) 明确规定，法院可以依职权下令进行新的审判，但必须在判决作出后 28天内 (within 28 days after the entry of judgment)。

在本案中，判决已作出60天，法院已经失去了根据 FRCP 59 下令重审的管辖权。因此，无论理由多么充分，法官都不能再下令进行新的审判。

干扰项排除
选项 A (错误)：
错误地认为法官不能依职权 (sua sponte) 下令重审。实际上法官有权这样做，只是必须在28天内。
选项 C (错误)：
混淆了 FRCP 60(a)（更正笔误）和 FRCP 59（新审判）。虽然在上诉立案前法院可以更正笔误，但这不适用于批准“新的审判”。
选项 D (错误)：
虽然陪审员不当行为是重审的理由，但法院并非“必须”(must) 下令，这通常是自由裁量权。更重要的是，28天的时效是硬性规定，超过时效即便是正当理由也无法依此规则救济。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for fraud in federal court. The complaint contained a short and plain statement of facts giving rise to the claim. One week after being served with process, the defendant filed and served an answer that denied the plaintiff's allegations. Five days later, the defendant filed and served a motion for a more definite statement. The motion alleged that the complaint failed to state the circumstances giving rise to the claim with particularity and specified the details that needed to be included.
Should the court grant the defendant's motion?

choices.A: No, because the complaint contained a short and plain statement of the facts giving rise to the claim.
choices.B: No, because the motion was filed after the defendant's responsive pleading was filed.
choices.C: Yes, because the circumstances giving rise to the claim must be stated with particularity.
choices.D: Yes, because the motion was filed within 21 days after the defendant was served with process.

questions.explanation:
FRCP 12 motions
Motion asserting any of the following defenses:
12(b)
  • Lack of subject-matter or personal jurisdiction
  • Improper venue
  • Insufficient process or service of process
  • Failure to state claim upon which relief can be granted
  • Failure to join required party
12(c) Motion for judgment on the pleadings
12(e) Motion for more definite statement in pleading
12(f) Motion to strike insufficient defense or immaterial matter from pleading
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12(e) allows a party to move for a more definite statement of a pleading that is so vague or ambiguous that the party cannot reasonably draft a responsive pleading. This motion is appropriate when a complaint does not contain the requisite specificity—eg, fails to state the circumstances giving rise to a fraud claim with particularity. A motion for a more definite statement must:

  • specify the pleading's defects and the details needed to cure these defects and
  • be made before filing a responsive pleading (eg, answer).*

If the court grants the motion, the nonmovant must provide a more definite statement within 14 days after receiving notice of the order or a time otherwise set by the court. Failure to do so allows the court to strike the pleading or issue another appropriate order.

Here, the defendant's motion for a more definite statement alleged that the plaintiff's complaint failed to state the circumstances giving rise to the fraud claim with particularity and specified the details sought to cure this defect. However, the motion was not timely since it was filed after the answer. Therefore, the court should deny the defendant's motion.

*Since the purpose of a motion for a more definite statement is to help a party adequately answer a vague pleading, the motion must be made before the answer is filed.

(Choices A & C) A complaint generally need only contain a short and plain statement of the claim showing that the plaintiff is entitled to relief. However, the circumstances giving rise to a fraud claim must be stated with particularity.

(Choice D) A defendant generally must file an answer within 21 days after being served with process. Here, the defendant timely filed and served an answer one week after being served with process. But the motion for a more definite statement was untimely since it was made after the defendant filed an answer.

📌 Educational Objective

A party may move for a more definite statement of a pleading that is so vague or ambiguous that the party cannot reasonably draft a responsive pleading. This motion must (1) specify the pleading's defects and the details sought that will cure these defects and (2) be made before filing a responsive pleading.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(e) (motion for a more definite statement).
  • 61A Am. Jur. 2d Pleading § 416 (2019) (explaining that a motion for a more definite statement must be made before an answer is filed).
questions.zh-question:
一名原告在联邦法院以欺诈为由起诉一名被告。起诉状包含了一份简明扼要的事实陈述，说明了诉求的起因。在收到诉讼文书一周后，被告提交并送达了一份否认原告指控的答辩状。五天后，被告提交并送达了一份要求更明确陈述的动议。该动议声称，起诉状未能具体陈述产生诉求的情形，并指明了需要补充的细节。

法院是否应批准被告的动议？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为起诉状包含了对产生诉求事实的简明扼要的陈述。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为该动议是在被告提交应诉状之后提出的。
zh-choices.C: 应，因为产生诉求的情形必须具体陈述。
zh-choices.D: 应，因为该动议是在被告收到诉讼文书后21天内提出的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析：FRCP 12(e)

本题考察的是联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP）中关于“更明确陈述动议” (Motion for a More Definite Statement) 的程序性要求，特别是时间节点的问题。

核心结论：
法院应当拒绝 (Deny) 被告的动议。虽然原告的起诉状确实存在缺陷（欺诈需具体陈述），但被告提出动议的时机是错误的。

1 法律规则详解 (The Rule)

根据 FRCP 12(e)，如果一份诉状（Pleading）含糊不清或模棱两可，导致对方无法合理地准备回应，当事人可以提出“更明确陈述动议”。

关键的时间限制：

该动议必须在提交应诉状 (Responsive Pleading) 之前 提出。

逻辑： 如果你已经提交了答辩状（Answer），说明你已经能够理解诉状并对其进行承认或否认。因此，你在逻辑上已经不再需要“更明确的陈述”了。

2 本案时间线分析

第 0 天： 被告收到诉讼文书 (Served with process)。
第 7 天： 被告提交并送达了答辩状 (Answer)。
⚠️ 此时被告已丧失提出 12(e) 动议的权利。
第 12 天： 被告提出 12(e) 动议。
结果：动议过时 (Untimely)。

3 陷阱辨析：欺诈的特殊性

本题设置了一个极具诱惑性的陷阱，即关于欺诈 (Fraud) 的陈述要求。

规则 要求
FRCP 8(a)
一般规则		 "Short and plain statement"
简明扼要的陈述即可。
FRCP 9(b)
欺诈/错误		 "With particularity"
必须具体陈述（时间、地点、内容等）。

考点分析：

  • 原告确实违反了 FRCP 9(b)，起诉状是有缺陷的。
  • 如果被告在答辩之前提出动议，法院会批准。
  • 但是，程序规则 (Timing) 在此处优先。被告先提交了答辩状，这一行为豁免 (Waived) 了其要求更明确陈述的权利。

4 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 MBE 民事诉讼题目时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 检查动议类型：是 12(b)(6) 驳回起诉？还是 12(e) 更明确陈述？
  2. 检查时间顺序：动议是在答辩状 (Answer) 之前还是之后？
    • 12(e) 动议：必须在答辩前。
    • 12(b) 动议：部分必须在答辩前（如管辖权异议），部分可以在审判前提出。
  3. 不要被实体问题带偏：即使原告的诉状写得很烂（实体缺陷），如果被告违反了程序规则（如逾期），动议依然会被驳回。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A jury sitting in a federal court case returned a verdict that found in favor of the plaintiff and awarded her $100,000. The federal district court entered a final judgment consistent with the jury's verdict.
The defendant immediately filed a notice of appeal, alleging that the district court erred by failing to exclude several pieces of evidence from the jury's consideration. The appellate court docketed the case. The day after the appeal was docketed, the district court discovered that the final judgment listed a $1,000,000 award for the plaintiff.
May the district court correct the mistake?

choices.A: No, because both parties must receive notice and an opportunity to be heard on this action.
choices.B: No, because leave of the appellate court is required once an appeal is docketed.
choices.C: Yes, because a district court may correct clerical mistakes on its own initiative.
choices.D: Yes, because a district court may freely alter and amend final judgments in the interest of justice.

questions.explanation:
Explanation
Posttrial correction of mistakes
(FRCP 60(a))
Type of mistake Definition Time of correction
Clerical Misstatement of court's intent
  • Eg, court entered judgment for "$10,000" instead of "$100,000"
  • Before appeal docketed: on court's own initiative or by motion
  • After appeal docketed: with appellate court's leave
Oversight/omission Exclusion misrepresents court's intent
  • Eg, judgment failed to include required interest in award
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A district court may correct a clerical mistake or a mistake arising from an oversight or omission in a judgment, order, or other part of the record. The court may do so on its own initiative or pursuant to a party's motion before an appeal from the judgment or order is docketed. But after an appeal is docketed, the district court can correct the mistake only with the appellate court's leave (ie, permission).

Here, a clerical mistake occurred since the jury's verdict awarded the plaintiff $100,000 but the final judgment awarded her $1,000,000. Since the appeal has been docketed, the district court cannot correct the mistake without leave of the appellate court.

(Choice A) A district court need not provide the parties with notice or an opportunity to be heard before it corrects a mistake.

(Choice C) The district court could have corrected the mistake on its own initiative had the appeal not been docketed.

(Choice D) A district court cannot freely alter or amend final judgments. It may do so only when (1) the judgment is based on a manifest error of law or fact, (2) the controlling law has changed, or (3) new evidence is discovered.

📌 Educational Objective

Before an appeal is docketed in the appellate court, a district court can correct a mistake in a judgment, order, or other part of the record on its own initiative or pursuant to a party's motion. But after an appeal has been docketed, the district court can correct the mistake only with the appellate court's leave.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 60(a) (correction of mistake in judgment or order).
questions.zh-question:
一个联邦法院案件的陪审团作出了一项有利于原告的裁决，并判给其100,000美元。联邦地区法院根据陪审团的裁决，作出了一项终局判决。

被告立即提交了上诉通知，声称地区法院因未能将几项证据排除在陪审团的考量之外而犯了错误。上诉法院已将该案立卷。在上诉立卷的第二天，地区法院发现终局判决中列出的原告赔偿金为1,000,000美元。

地区法院可以纠正这个错误吗？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为双方当事人都必须收到关于此项行动的通知并有机会就此发表意见。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为一旦上诉立卷，就需要获得上诉法院的许可。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为地区法院可以主动纠正笔误。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为地区法院为了司法公正可以自由地更改和修正终局判决。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Correction of Mistakes
⚖️ 核心考点：FRCP 60(a)

联邦民事诉讼规则第 60(a) 条 规定了法院如何纠正判决中的“笔误”（Clerical Mistakes）。

关键在于时间点：一旦上诉在上诉法院立卷（Docketed），地区法院就失去了单方面纠正错误的管辖权。

📝 案情关键点分析

本案中，陪审团裁决 $100,000，但判决书写成了 $1,000,000。这显然是一个笔误 (Clerical Mistake)，即判决未能正确反映法院或陪审团的真实意图，而非实质性的法律错误。

但是，题目中有一个决定性的时间节点：“The appellate court docketed the case” (上诉法院已将该案立卷)。

判决作出 (Judgment Entered)
存在笔误 ($1M vs $100k)
提交上诉通知 (Notice of Appeal Filed)
此时地区法院通常仍有权纠正笔误
上诉立卷 (Appeal Docketed) ⚠️
管辖权转移！ 案件正式进入上诉法院系统。
地区法院发现错误
此时若要纠正，必须获得上诉法院的许可 (Leave of the appellate court)。

✅ 正确答案：选项 B

理由：根据 FRCP 60(a)，在上诉立卷（docketed）之后，地区法院纠正笔误的权力受到限制，必须先获得上诉法院的许可（Leave）。如果没有这个许可，地区法院无权修改判决。

❌ 选项 A 错误
FRCP 60(a) 允许法院在“不通知”的情况下纠正笔误（虽然通常会通知）。这里的核心障碍不是通知（Notice），而是管辖权（Jurisdiction）。
❌ 选项 C 错误
如果上诉尚未立卷，法院确实可以“主动”（on its own initiative）纠正。但本题明确指出案件已立卷，因此该选项不再适用。
❌ 选项 D 错误
地区法院不能“自由地”（freely）更改终局判决。修改判决有严格的标准（如 FRCP 59(e) 或 60(b)），且“为了司法公正”这一理由过于宽泛，不能凌驾于上诉期间的管辖权规则之上。
💡 MBE 答题技巧

在涉及上诉 (Appeal) 的题目中，务必区分两个动作：
  1. Filing Notice of Appeal（提交上诉通知）：通常在地区法院进行。
  2. Docketing the Appeal（上诉立卷）：在上诉法院进行。
FRCP 60(a) 的分界线是“Docketing”。看到这个词，就要立刻反应：地区法院的手被束缚了，需要上级法院点头（Leave）才能动笔。
